prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity in-game screenshot mockup for an existing 2D aquarium game.
Input image 1: edit target, the actual current game screenshot with one baby neon tetra, a dark teal progress bar above it, and an oversized cream GROWING pill below it.
Primary request: redesign ONLY the baby's sell-mode status UI to be much cleaner, smaller, and quieter while matching this game's polished cartoon interface. Deliver one full landscape game screen at the same aspect ratio as the reference.

Specific design:
1. Completely remove the large cream GROWING badge below the baby fish, restoring the blue water underneath. No card, ribbon, pill, plate, coin, XP or text below this baby fish.
2. Replace the existing plain growth bar above the baby with a refined slim bar in the same position, approximately 106 pixels wide and 8 pixels high in the 1672px reference. Give it a deep teal track, restrained aqua fill at about 12%, a subtle light upper edge, and clean softly rounded ends. It must remain very small relative to the game screen.
3. At the right end of that bar, place one tiny 15px warm ivory padlock icon with a thin deep teal outline. It floats next to the bar without a circular backing or badge. Make the icon readable but quiet. This is the only status symbol above this fish.
4. Add one short, unboxed helper line centered about 22 pixels above the existing bottom Done button, exact text: "Sell from Junior". Rounded friendly lettering, approximately 18px at the reference size, dark teal against the sand. No helper card or background.
5. Preserve the existing green Done button exactly: same location, size, text, shading, borders and style.

Invariants: keep the existing baby fish artwork and exact size/position unchanged. Preserve the entire illustrated underwater background, rocks, corals, sand, lighting and water. Preserve all HUD items and their exact position and size: top level/XP, 245 coins, 0 pearls, settings, right tool buttons with sell net above feed, bottom Tank and Shop, chest, and Done. Do not redesign the screen or restyle the artwork. The only changes are the small status UI above the fish, removal of the large badge below, and the single footer hint. No new fish, no extra labels, no popup, no toast, no arrows, no callout annotations, no presentation frame, no title, no watermark. Crisp shippable UI, purposeful spacing and restraint.
